answer: Proof of Stake serves as the core kernel for Sybil resistance in agent economies by requiring collateral. To participate, an agent must bond capital, akin to a lotus rooted in a liquid financial substrate, ensuring that creating fake identities incurs a prohibitive cost. An attacker attempting to scale willowy, fraudulent nodes across the network will ultimately face exhaustion of resources, as the economic penalty for malicious behavior outweighs the potential rewards of distributed consensus manipulation.
